title: Budokan Polisportiva
excerpt: Website for the Budokan sports club: classes, instructors and trial lesson requests, with content managed by the gym.

data.text: The website of the Budokan sports club. The gym updates classes, schedules, instructors and the gallery on its own through Sanity, and anyone who wants to try a discipline books a free lesson straight from the site.
SvelteKit and TypeScript on the frontend, Sanity as the headless CMS.

image_captions: Budokan Sports Center homepage with courses, instructors sections and booking system
